nativeGroups.readOrder: Construct the route, link its bus-side list, select the existing output node and admit the channel layout; failed channel admission removes the new route.
Allocate route storage; retain source and bus pointers, create a row and insert at the source-side list head. The bus-side link is a different field.
Initialize descriptor, gain, filter and matrix fields of one route row.
Grow inline or allocated fixed-stride route-row storage; preserve existing rows through original move and cleanup routines.
Construct and publish one fixed-stride row, insert its exact key into the route hash and unwind row state on insertion failure.
Use the XOR hash only to find candidates; require full key and secondary-key equality before reusing the row, otherwise append.
Bounded occupied-bucket probing for the exact DWORD candidate key.
Return the retained bus channel configuration.
Return the retained bus descriptor address.
Resolve authored or fallback output identity through the supplied existing output-node lists; match the original identity and ownership predicates.
Accept nonstandard/small configurations directly; otherwise require cached or newly created speaker-layout state. Missing state returns failure.
Match channel count, configuration kind and speaker mask before returning a cache value location.
Require retained output format/geometry state before creating a speaker-layout cache entry; allocation or construction failure removes the entry.
Find a retained route with the exact bus pointer and remove it through the iterator-based native unlink.
Remove the same route from source and bus lists, decrement the bus count and release original row/storage state.
Resize typed auxiliary row records through the retained allocator; no records are modeled.

Run original owner refresh, derive linear context gain from retained level and effective gain, then refresh optional auxiliary routes. The constructor default context gain is zero until this stage runs.
Refresh owner auxiliary policy and any existing auxiliary rows, then dispatch route-state update.
Query retained owner auxiliary policy under its native exclusion/override conditions.
Refresh source level-to-linear conversion and retain the cached value; read optional wrapper gain factors only when present.
Combine context gain and refreshed source level, publish route target gains and build matrices for the selected channel layout; preserve previous parameter snapshots.
Prepare matching standard-layout matrices and route filter state; swap current/target matrix storage and retain transition fields.
Prepare anonymous-layout channel matrices; channel dimensions and row lifetime remain typed conditions.
Reinitialize original filter history when the typed channel count changes.
Allocate bounded channel-matrix storage for the supplied dimensions.
Release retained channel-matrix storage.
Walk the bus-side route list. Exclude routes when both low status bits are set or the third bit is set; collect the remaining route pointers and row count.
Admit rows with a published descriptor, allocated matrix and sample/end descriptor state; collect native row/gain/filter arrays and invoke native mixing.
Obtain or construct an output descriptor, pad source rows, combine route and row gains and dispatch the original filter/matrix/gain mixer into native bus storage.
Insert generated output identity into a native hash, append the output descriptor, construct metadata and associate optional effects; failure cleans the inserted state.
Grow typed bus-input descriptors while preserving their retained metadata.
Initialize one bus output descriptor and allocate its original metadata with default unit gains.
Associate a new output descriptor with any retained effect chain; an empty chain returns unchanged.
Keep an existing PCM pointer or allocate a frame buffer through the native transient arena; populate channel configuration and capacity.
Allocate aligned bytes from per-thread cached or globally supplied transient blocks. Arena configuration and block lifetime are caller preconditions.
Classify native filter rows, run the selected filter and matrix/gain accumulation paths and return caller-supplied anonymous result storage; empty optional outputs remain empty.
Remove ended input records, then clear each retained input PCM pointer/valid count and reset its status for a new frame. Original metadata and channel capacity can be reused.
Advance retained route row/filter transition state and clear per-frame published descriptor pointers.
Release the bus input metadata and its optional auxiliary storage; optional scalar-delete flags release the descriptor allocation.
Generate a masked monotonically incremented output identity; it is not an authored Event or media ID.
Initialize a DWORD-key hash with explicit allocator, initial capacity, value size and alignment.
Initialize a QWORD-key hash with explicit allocator, initial capacity, value size and alignment.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected native inputs, complete exception/unwind extents and bounded leaves, native route/list/row, channel-cache, context-gain, bus admission/matrix-mix/allocation/reset instructions and direct call/tail edges on the same opened image as the voice pipeline.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Attachment creates one route with separate source and bus links; its original row receives the exact source descriptor. The bus collector excludes native route status bits and requires descriptor sample/end status plus matrix storage. Context gain refresh precedes route gain publication; its constructor default is zero. Original bus output construction and filter/matrix mixing create a separate PCM allocation. Bus frame reset clears that retained descriptor before the next accumulation.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Anonymous source/bus/route/effect storage and output identities remain native field facts; class names and a complete authored bus hierarchy are not inferred.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Three offline numeric-source cohorts supply one typed bus/output identity, a matching cached stereo channel layout, an available transient arena, empty auxiliary/effect chains, owner authored-parameter exclusion, worker ordering, unit-rate pitch and finite COM surfaces. Original attachment, nonempty route preparation, gain refresh, row/matrix construction, bus admission, mix, frame reset and sink submission preserve every logical native sample value with final zero padding; byte equality is separate because native accumulation can normalize signed-zero bits. No source-to-bus descriptor is copied or sample arithmetic modeled by the helper.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Authored bus/owner/device selection and parameter/effect inputs, full engine scheduler and transient arena startup/lifetime, different routing/filter/rate/transition branches, concurrent teardown and real endpoint/COM acceptance or audible output.
